# source: LaTeX2e's standard classes (classes.dtx), the book class's chapters and divisions: \chapter
# opens a page under its word and number, as report's does; \frontmatter, \mainmatter and
# \backmatter each open a page, and only the main matter's chapters number. The rows probe the
# body of a book (the `class` place).
class impl \chapter{An invented title}
class impl \frontmatter
class impl \mainmatter
class impl \backmatter
